title: Docs: Fix supported versions typo
body:
Related issue: none. This is a documentation-only typo fix.

## What I did

- Fixed a typo in the supported versions docs by changing `recieves` to `receives`.

## Checklist for Contributors

- [ ] stories
- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] integration tests
- [ ] end-to-end tests

#### Manual testing

No manual testing required for this one-word documentation fix.

### Documentation

- [x] Add or update documentation reflecting your changes
- [ ] If you are deprecating/removing a feature, make sure to update [MIGRATION.MD](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md)

- [ ] Make sure this PR contains **one** of the labels below:
  <details>
    <summary>Available labels</summary>

- `bug`: Internal changes that fixes incorrect behavior.
- `maintenance`: User-facing maintenance tasks.
- `dependencies`: Upgrading (sometimes downgrading) dependencies.
- `build`: Internal-facing build tooling & test updates. Will not show up in release changelog.
- `cleanup`: Minor cleanup style change. Will not show up in release changelog.
- `documentation`: Documentation **only** changes. Will not show up in release changelog.
- `feature request`: Introducing a new feature.
- `BREAKING CHANGE`: Changes that break compatibility in some way with current major version.
- `other`: Changes that don't fit in the above categories.

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Use the plural verb here.**

`Older versions` is plural, so this should be `receive`, not `receives`.

<details>
<summary>✏️ Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-- Older versions: No longer receives any patches
+- Older versions: No longer receive any patches
```
</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

```suggestion
- Older versions: No longer receive any patches
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
docs/releases/index.mdx for the line containing "Older versions:" so it reads
"Older versions: No longer receive any patches" ensuring the subject "Older
versions" agrees with "receive".
```
